nodes.name: permission.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the permission HttpApi contract: GET /permission lists pending permission requests and POST /permission/:requestID/reply approves or denies them, wired through instance-context, workspace-routing, and authorization middleware.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Effect's declarative HttpApi DSL (HttpApi.make / HttpApiGroup / HttpApiEndpoint) with annotateMerge(OpenApi.annotations(...)) so the OpenAPI spec is generated from the same code that types the endpoints.

nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the project HttpApi contract: list projects, get the current project, initialize a git repository, and PATCH project properties such as name, icon, and commands.

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the provider HttpApi contract: list AI providers, retrieve available auth methods, and drive per-provider OAuth authorize and callback flows.

nodes.name: pty.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the PTY HttpApi contract: shell discovery, PTY session CRUD, and short-lived WebSocket connect tokens, plus a separate PtyConnectApi for the WebSocket connect endpoint. Also exports the shared Params, CursorQuery, ShellItem, and PtyPaths route constants consumed by the PTY handlers.

nodes.name: query.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the QueryBoolean schema, a 'true'/'false' string literal that decodes to a boolean for query strings, along with its anyOf OpenAPI representation. Shared by the v1 session list and v2 sessions list query schemas.

nodes.name: question.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the question HttpApi contract: list pending question requests, reply with ordered answer selections, and reject a question request from the AI assistant.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the session HttpApi contract, the largest route group with 28 endpoints: session CRUD, status maps, children, todos, per-message diffs, message/part retrieval and editing, fork, abort, share/unshare, init, summarize, next-prompt prediction, prompt (sync and async), command, shell, revert/unrevert, and permission responses. Also exports the SessionPaths route map plus query and payload schemas reused across handlers.
nodes.languageNotes: Payload schemas derive from service input types via Struct.omit(Input.fields, ["sessionID"]) so the route layer stays in sync with the session service contract; query booleans reuse the shared QueryBoolean literal-to-boolean transform.

nodes.name: sync.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the sync HttpApi contract for the workspace sync event system: start sync loops, validate and replay a full event history, steal a session into the current workspace, and list incremental sync events keyed by per-aggregate sequence cursors.

nodes.name: tui.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the TUI HttpApi contract: 13 endpoints for remote-controlling the terminal UI, including append/submit/clear prompt, opening help/session/theme/model dialogs, toasts, event publishing, session selection, and the control request/response queue.

nodes.name: v2.ts
nodes.summary: Composes the v2 HttpApi by adding the SessionGroup and MessageGroup under the 'v2' API title; a thin barrel over the experimental v2 route surface.

nodes.name: message.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the v2.message HttpApi group: a cursor-paginated GET /api/session/:sessionID/message endpoint returning projected v2 messages with limit/order controls and opaque previous/next cursors.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the v2.session HttpApi group: cursor-paginated session listing over the v2 session store, prompt queuing with optional delivery mode, compaction, wait-for-idle, and active-context retrieval (messages after the last compaction).

nodes.name: workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the experimental workspace HttpApi contract: list/create/remove control-plane workspaces, list workspace adapters, register adapter-provided workspaces, check connection status, and warp a session's sync history into a target workspace. Declares the ApiWorkspaceWarpError schema error (HTTP 400).

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the config route group: get and update instance config (marking the instance for disposal after an update) and list configured providers with their default model IDs.

nodes.name: control.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the server-wide control route group registered on RootHttpApi rather than the instance API: set and remove provider auth credentials and forward client log messages into the server logger.

nodes.name: experimental.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the experimental route group: console/org state and switching, tool listing with JSON-schema parameters, worktree sandbox create/remove/reset, global session search with x-next-cursor pagination headers, and MCP resource listing.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the file route group: ripgrep text search, fuzzy file search, directory listing, file content reading, and file subsystem status via the File and Ripgrep services.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the server-wide global route group on RootHttpApi: health check, SSE event stream (server.connected plus GlobalBus events with 10-second heartbeats), global config get/update with instance disposal, and self-upgrade. Holds the SSE stream builder used by the event endpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: handleRaw endpoints (event, upgrade) bypass the typed HttpApi pipeline and return raw HttpServerResponse objects, e.g. the SSE stream with no-cache, no-transform, and nosniff headers.

nodes.name: instance.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the instance route group: dispose, path info, VCS branch/status/diff/apply (mapping apply failures to the ApiVcsApplyError schema error), and listing commands, agents, skills, LSP servers, and formatters for the current instance.

nodes.name: mcp.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the MCP route group: server status, adding servers with decoded status maps, OAuth start/callback/authenticate/remove guarded by UnsupportedOAuthError for non-OAuth servers, and connect/disconnect control.

nodes.name: permission.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the permission route group: list pending permission requests and approve or deny them through Permission.Service reply.

nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the project route group: list projects, resolve the current project from instance context, init git (reloading the instance when the project identity changes), and update project properties.

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the provider route group: merges the models.dev catalog with connected providers while applying enabled/disabled config filters, exposes auth methods, and drives OAuth authorize (including a raw variant preserving legacy JSON-null behavior) and callback flows.

nodes.name: pty.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the PTY route group (shell listing, session CRUD, origin-checked connect-token issuance) and ptyConnectRoute, a raw HttpRouter WebSocket endpoint that validates one-time tickets, registers with WebSocketTracker, and bridges the socket to a PTY session with cursor-based output replay.
nodes.languageNotes: The WebSocket handshake fires inside socket.runRaw AFTER pty.connect registers its message callback, so no early-frame buffer is needed — an invariant carried over from the legacy Hono handler and documented in-code.

nodes.name: question.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the question route group: list pending questions, submit ordered answer replies, and reject question requests through Question.Service.

nodes.name: eventResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the SSE event-stream response for the global event endpoint: a synthetic server.connected event, GlobalBus subscriptions via Stream.callback with acquireRelease cleanup, 10-second heartbeats, merged with halt-on-left strategy and SSE-encoded with no-cache headers.

nodes.name: ApiWorkspaceWarpError
nodes.summary: Schema-defined HttpApi error (HTTP 400) carrying a WarpError name and message payload, returned by the workspace warp endpoint when moving a session's sync history fails.
